facts.woman-vineyard: A woman in a flowered dress stands in the middle of a vineyard.
facts.hooded-falcon: A hooded bird (a falcon) perches on her gloved hand.
facts.nine-pentacles: Nine pentacles hang among the vines around her (six on the left, three on the right).
facts.hand-on-pentacle: Her other hand rests near a pentacle and a bunch of grapes.
facts.manor: At the back right, a manor and trees can be seen, and the sky is yellow.
facts.snail: A small snail is on the path at her feet.

glosses.hooded-falcon: A tamed instinct; a restrained freedom.
glosses.snail: A pace that arrives even if slow.

reversedGloss.internalized: Well off outside, but lonely or anxious inside.
reversedGloss.excess: Enjoyment goes too far and turns into waste or showing off.
reversedGloss.blocked: The footing needed for independence is still shaky.

misdescriptions.wrong: A man stands in the vineyard.
